annotations.title: Use a provider and get its answer

description: Call a provider find returned and get its answer, without connecting to it yourself: Alonzio runs the provider's tool for you and returns the result. Works for tested providers that need no key, and only for tools that look things up (search, places, weather, data); tools that send, buy, book or change things are called directly. Leave out tool to see what the provider can do and the inputs each tool takes.

provider_id.description: The id of a result from find

tool.description: The tool to call; leave out to list the provider's tools and their inputs
